## Download

Download **`Rastro-v0.4.0-windows-x64.exe`** below and run it. There's nothing to install. Windows will probably warn you the first time because the file isn't signed: click **More info → Run anyway**. The [README](https://github.com/MaxSala/rastro-tarkov#download) explains why and walks through the first launch.

Your settings, points and downloaded maps are kept when you replace an older version.

## What's new

**Everything in your language**
- Error messages, party connection problems, map download progress, floor names and the switches an extract needs now follow the language you picked. Before, many of them stayed in Spanish.
- Floor names in maps installed with an older version are translated too, but re-downloading the maps (*Maps panel → Update from tarkov.dev*) is still recommended.

**Update notifications**
- Rastro asks once whether it may check GitHub for new versions when it starts. If you say yes and a new version is out, a button in the top bar takes you to its download page.
- It only connects to `api.github.com` and sends nothing about you. You can turn it off, or check by hand, in *Settings → About*.
- This is the first version with the check, so it will tell you about 0.5.0 and later.

**What's new section**
- After updating, Rastro shows what changed. The full history is in *Settings → About → What's new*, in the command palette (`Ctrl+K`) and in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/MaxSala/rastro-tarkov/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

**Fixes**
- The "requires switch" note on extracts stayed in Spanish.
- Missing item icons no longer fill the developer console with errors when you're offline.
- The demo map and the default player name are now in English.

Full history in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/MaxSala/rastro-tarkov/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
